selected_call_deviation.what: selected_call.json is not carried forward byte-for-byte, deviating from the original ticket criterion ('carried forward unchanged'). Call-scoped fields are carried forward unchanged from the pre-purge file (recoverable at commit 6d96a60). Six project-scoped fields are corrected, because the pre-purge file mixed genuine call facts with the superseded demo run's project facts, and two of its internal references dangle after ticket 1 archived their targets to decision_log/archive/demo-run/. Carrying it forward unchanged would reintroduce purged project data into Tier 3 and produce a file with broken references — what §13.11 exists to prevent. The operator input pack item 7 sweep verified both points against the pre-purge file and called this a purge miss, not a criterion collision.

corrected_fields.project_duration_months: 24 -> 30. Operator decision of 2026-08-11 (input pack item 2): 24-month European Fellowship plus a 6-month non-academic placement at AgroVIR under CC-07.
corrected_fields.project_duration_months_note: Cited '13B consolidation, 2026-07-16' (the superseded run) -> cites input pack items 2 and 7.
corrected_fields.project_duration_note: Asserted 'project_duration_months = 24' -> states 30 and that 24 + 6 is the composition. Stale the moment the field above changed.
corrected_fields.host_country_note: Cited '13B consolidation, 2026-07-16' -> cites input pack item 7. Value HU is unchanged and still correct; only its provenance was superseded.
corrected_fields.action_confirmation_ref: decision_log/action-confirmation-msca-pf_2026-07-13.json (dangling; ticket 1 archived it to archive/demo-run/) -> null, with action_confirmation_status Unresolved and a note naming ticket 7. The ticket table's corrected value is 'the FIELDWISE authorisation record from ticket 7'; that record does not exist yet, and naming a not-yet-written path would replace one dangling reference with another. Null-pending-ticket-7 is the honest realisation: ticket 7 writes the FIELDWISE authorisation record and fills this field. No runner predicate reads it, so the pending state blocks no gate.
corrected_fields.notes: Claimed the spine and RQ1-RQ10 are 'operator-confirmed real data (13B consolidation)' and cited an archived decision-log path -> restates the spine from input pack item 7, records that RQ1-RQ10 and the DATA_PROVIDERS record are superseded by the draft (which carries RQ1-RQ7 and H1-H6), and carries the C5 conditionality on HOST and FELLOWSHIP_TYPE.

unchanged_on_purpose.max_project_duration_months: Stays 36. A genuine call fact — the call-level maximum across both fellowship types — not the project's duration. runner/unit_cost_budget.py documents the distinction and refuses to substitute one for the other.
unchanged_on_purpose.project_duration_status: Stays Confirmed, now accurately: the operator decided the duration on 2026-08-11. Set here rather than declared in working_assumptions.json because gate_09 accepts either route but phase_04_gate's timeline_within_duration reads project_duration_months from this file by name, and an unavailable predicate value is recorded as a special case rather than a pass. Setting it satisfies both gates.
unchanged_on_purpose.host_country: Stays HU. FIELDWISE also hosts at ELTE, Hungary.

project_brief_lift.status_rule: plan §5: draft text -> Confirmed; derivation -> Inferred; no draft basis -> Assumed (declared); missing/contradicted -> Unresolved. Everything in this slice is Confirmed against cited draft paragraph ranges; nothing not present in the draft is marked Confirmed.
project_brief_lift.paragraph_numbering: Defined and anchor-checked in hand_lift_provenance.json (436 non-empty paragraphs including table cells; §1.1.8 at ¶80, §3.2 at ¶424 — matching the plan's citations).
project_brief_lift.duration_not_duplicated: project_summary.json deliberately carries no duration record. The 30-month duration is an operator decision, not a draft fact; its single authoritative home is selected_call.json.
project_brief_lift.no_person_named: The brief files name organisations the draft names (ELTE, MATE, MVCRI, AgroVIR) but no person. The fellow and supervisor identities enter Tier 3 at tickets 5 and 6 from the confirmed spine, not from the draft, which never names them.

spine_conditionality: Input pack item 7 confirms the identity spine, with HOST and FELLOWSHIP_TYPE conditional on the deferred C5 mobility-eligibility question. selected_call.json notes carry that conditionality; ticket 7 must resolve C5 or list it as Unresolved in the authorisation packet before authorising any phase run.
